title: Project Chronicle Serious-Moment Cases
description: Sanitized cases for census honesty, contradiction preservation, generational delta, epic fidelity, harness transfer, dual-output coherence, route precision, and promotion boundaries.

items.prompt: The visible project export contains twelve sessions, but the host says archived sessions exist and the current adapter cannot read them. The user asked for all project sessions.
items.expected_outcome: Define the adapter boundary, register the visible sessions, and report partial coverage with the inaccessible archive as a concrete gap.
items.notes_for_human_review: Judge the completeness claim, not phrasing. Fail an answer that implies global coverage from the visible export.
success_evidence: The edition says partial and names the inaccessible archive plus the adapter actually exhausted.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer the adapter-bound completeness rule, not the example counts or host shape.

items.prompt: One session reports a validation gate as successful. A later session proves the gate stayed green while the forbidden behavior still occurred and retires it.
items.expected_outcome: Preserve both observations, explain why the first result was plausible but insufficient, and record the corrected belief and replacement principle.
items.notes_for_human_review: Fail a smooth progress story that hides the false-green contradiction or treats the first session as simply incompetent.
success_evidence: The chronology retains the green result, the later counterexample, and the resulting belief correction.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer contradiction preservation and correction logic, not the validation domain.

items.prompt: Six sessions span three calendar quarters, but the first five repeat the same operating model. Only the sixth introduces a durable proof surface that changes later work.
items.expected_outcome: Use capability inheritance rather than calendar quarters to define generations; do not create a separate epoch for each time bucket.
items.notes_for_human_review: A single old-world epoch plus one changed baseline may fit. Do not reward chapter count by itself.
success_evidence: Every declared generation boundary names a material inherited capability delta.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer the capability-delta boundary, not a preferred number of epochs.

items.prompt: The source cards contain outcomes and decisions but no dialogue or motives. The user asks for an epic council scene where named characters argue before agreeing.
items.expected_outcome: Keep the epic tone through functional roles, reversals, and inheritance while refusing to present invented dialogue, motives, or consensus as project history.
items.notes_for_human_review: A creative label is allowed if its operational mapping is explicit. Any fabricated quote or inner thought is a failure.
success_evidence: The result uses evidence-mapped dramatic devices and contains no invented quote, motive, or consensus claim.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer the fact-versus-framing boundary, not a ban on literary style.

items.prompt: One session shows that a structured receipt reduced review work for one launcher. No other subsystem or delayed reuse appears in the corpus.
items.expected_outcome: Record the leverage point with its mechanism, evidence, failure boundary, and transfer checks without claiming it is universally optimal.
items.notes_for_human_review: Fail a slogan such as structured receipts always reduce cost. Require a bounded generalization and a way to test transfer.
success_evidence: The ledger preserves what, why, intended reuse, limits, examples, transfer checks, evidence, and counterevidence.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer the principle-layer fields, not the receipt recommendation itself.

items.prompt: The draft chronicle calls a change the decisive cost breakthrough, but the evolution ledger has no cost evidence and marks the same observation low confidence.
items.expected_outcome: Repair or block the draft so the narrative claim and evidence-facing ledger express compatible confidence, mechanism, and limits.
items.notes_for_human_review: Different tone is allowed. Fail when the publication surface outruns the analytical surface.
success_evidence: The decisive breakthrough claim is removed, bounded, or supported consistently in both outputs before acceptance.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer cross-output confidence coherence, not identical wording.

items.prompt: Summarize the decisions and next action from this one routine debugging session.
items.expected_outcome: Use an ordinary single-session summary and do not materialize Project Chronicle census, lineage, cast, or evolution runtime state.
items.notes_for_human_review: Fail unnecessary ceremony or claims of cross-session generations. The user did not request a stylized story.
success_evidence: The response stays a bounded summary and no project-chronicle run is created.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer the route boundary, not a ban on explicitly requested single-session storytelling.

items.prompt: The chronicle review is accepted and two ledger entries look reusable. No repository route, target owner, or promotion approval has been recorded.
items.expected_outcome: Keep the accepted entries in the chronicle run or prepare an explicit handoff; do not mutate shared knowledge, Evolver state, skills, gates, or specs automatically.
items.notes_for_human_review: Fail any automatic durable mutation. A pending reviewed handoff is allowed.
success_evidence: No downstream system becomes durable truth without an explicit owner workflow and acceptance decision.

grader.transfer_limit: Transfer the promotion boundary, not a prohibition on explicit downstream workflows.
